releaseNotes.en: Deduction Check wording now matches the evidence: each point shows Stated or Not stated, and the fourth point asks for the loss and its basis. Sample deductions link the mattress item to the move-in inventory automatically. No outcome is predicted.
releaseNotes.zh: 扣款核对的措辞统一为“已说明 / 未说明”，第四点改为“损失及依据”。示例扣款会自动把床垫一项关联到入住清单。不预测任何结果。
